name: NiceJob
summary: Automates asking customers for reviews and showcases them on your site. Reporting and customisation are fairly basic, and the automation only amplifies the service you already deliver.
best_for: local and service businesses that want reputation marketing on offense — automatically asking happy customers for reviews and showcasing them — rather than only managing damage when a bad review lands
skip_if: you need deep reporting or highly customized review workflows, or your service quality isn't ready for more visibility yet — fix that first, then amplify it
honest_knock: Reporting and customization are fairly basic, and the Sites website add-on carries a $199 setup fee on top of its $99 a month. It automates review collection genuinely well, but if you want deep analytics or granular control over timing and wording, it can feel restrictive. And the honest fundamental: automation only amplifies the service you actually deliver. It keeps the review stream fresh and steady (which matters — stale reviews lose trust fast, and AI search increasingly recommends businesses on review signals), but it cannot manufacture a reputation you haven't earned.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-13 on their own pricing page) Two software plans, both USD per month with a 14-day free trial, no contract and cancel anytime: Starter at $75 (SMS and email review requests, review widgets, social sharing, a team leaderboard and a reviews microsite) and Pro at $125 (everything in Starter plus Repeats, Referrals, Broadcasts, AI Replies, Gifts, NPS Surveys and Competitive Intel). Billing starts the day the trial ends, and a plan change in either direction takes effect on the next billing cycle. Sites, a fully managed website, is an add-on on either plan at $99 a month plus a one-off $199 setup; an extra landing page is $145 one-time plus $15 a month, and a CMS for blogs, services or locations is $245 one-time plus $15 a month. AI Leads is listed as coming soon with no price, and enterprise, franchise and multi-location pricing is on request.
